errors.evidence: The description completely fails to mention that the figure consists of three separate subplots. It also omits the main purpose of the figure, which is to illustrate how two correlated Brownian motions behave under different correlation coefficients (rho = 0.25, 0.5, and 0.75), as stated in the titles of the subplots.

errors.text_span: Първата графика показва синя линия с пунктиран стил, без маркери. ... Втората графика показва оранжева линия с пунктиран стил, без маркери.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the two lines (blue and orange) as two separate graphs ("Първата графика" and "Втората графика"). The figure actually contains three subplots, and each subplot contains both a blue and an orange line.

The description uses the Bulgarian word "коренливи" which means "rooty". The correct term, based on the plot titles ("Two corralated Brawnian motions"), should be "корелирани" (correlated). The word used is nonsensical in this context.

errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста X са показани на интервали от 100 единици.
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels are shown at intervals of 200 units (0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000), not 100 units.

errors.text_span: Оста Y показва стойности с линейна скала, варираща от -30 до 50 единици.
errors.evidence: This describes a single y-axis range for the entire figure. However, each of the three subplots has its own distinct y-axis range (approx. -35 to 15 for the left, -10 to 50 for the middle, and -25 to 30 for the right). The generalization is inaccurate and misleading.
The description incorrectly states that the lines have a "пунктиран стил" (dotted style). In all three plots, both the blue and orange lines are solid.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от около 14 единици на оста Y при 0 на оста X
errors.evidence: This claim about the blue line is incorrect. In all three subplots, the blue line starts at a value very close to 0, not 14.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от около -28 единици на оста Y при 0 на оста X
errors.evidence: This claim about the orange line is incorrect. In all three subplots, the orange line starts at a value very close to 0, not -28.

errors.text_span: нараства до приблизително 48 единици при 100 единици на оста X
errors.evidence: This claim about the blue line is false. A value of 48 is only reached in the middle plot, and it occurs at approximately x=450, not x=100. At x=100 in that same plot, the value is around 25.
